dialog.intro: Save your clubs to an account and open them on any device, or keep using {app} without one.
dialog.modeLabel: Sign in or create an account
dialog.name: Your name
dialog.nameHint: Optional. Only used in emails to you.
dialog.privacy: What an account stores and where: <link>privacy</link>.

resetRequest.intro: Enter the email you use for {app}. We'll send a link to choose a new password.
resetRequest.sent: If there's an account for {email}, we've sent it a link to choose a new password. The link works once, for one hour.

inbox.sent: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your email. Your clubs start saving to your account after that.
inbox.keepWorking: You're signed in already, so you can keep working. Nothing in this browser is lost.

errors.generic: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes.
errors.mismatch: That email and password don't match. Check them, or reset your password.
errors.invalidEmail: That doesn't look like an email address.
errors.exists: There's already an account with that email. Sign in instead.
errors.compromised: That password has shown up in a data leak. Pick a different one.
errors.notFresh: For your safety, sign out and sign in again first. Then you have a day to do this.
errors.offline: Couldn't reach {app}. Check your connection and try again.
errors.enterEmail: Enter your email address, like name@example.org.
errors.notSame: Those two don't match. Type the same password twice.

toasts.expiredSignedIn: Send a new one from the yellow message at the top.
toasts.expiredSignedOut: Sign in, and we'll offer to send a new one.
toasts.confirmedSignedIn: Your clubs save to your account from now on.
toasts.confirmedSignedOut: Sign in to save your clubs to your account.
toasts.googleFailed: Signing in with Google didn't work
toasts.googleFailedHint: Try again, or use your email and a password.

signOut.failed: Couldn't sign out. Check your connection and try again.
signOut.cleared: This browser is cleared. Your clubs are in your account.
signOut.kept: Your clubs are still in this browser.

menu.signOutClear: Sign out and clear this browser
menu.notSavedHint: This browser keeps its clubs for now. Try again once the header says Saved.

banner.label: Confirm your email
banner.body: Confirm your email to start saving your clubs to your account. We sent a link to {email}.

page.title: Storage and account
page.signedOutTitle: Sign in to see your account
page.signedOutBody: Your storage, uploaded images and account settings are here once you sign in. Without an account, your clubs stay in this browser.
page.confirmBody: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your email; your storage and images show up here after that. Until then, your clubs stay in this browser.
page.name: Name

storage.full: Your storage is full. Delete images you no longer use to make room; the studio keeps everything in this browser until then.
storage.counts: Crests, background photos, player cut-outs and sponsor logos you upload count towards this. Squads and match details don't.

images.title: Your images
images.empty: No images yet. Crests and photos you add in the studio show up here.
images.usedInAccount: Used in a club in your account
images.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete that image. Check your connection and try again.
images.deleted: {count, plural, one {Image deleted} other {# images deleted}}
images.confirmUnused: {count, plural, one {Delete # unused image?} other {Delete # unused images?}}
images.confirmUnusedBody: {count, plural, one {It isn't used in any club, in your account or in this browser. Your clubs stay as they are.} other {They aren't used in any club, in your account or in this browser. Your clubs stay as they are.}}
images.confirmOneBody: It's used in {places}. Deleting it removes it from there too, here and on your other devices.
images.confirmOneBodyAccount: It's used in a club in your account. Deleting it removes it from there too, here and on your other devices.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: Deleting your account removes the account, every club saved to it and all the images you uploaded. The clubs in this browser stay as they are.
delete.dialogBody: This can't be undone. Your saved clubs and uploaded images are deleted for good, on every device.
delete.deletedHint: The clubs in this browser are still here.

resetPage.howTo: Reset links work once, for one hour. In the studio, choose Sign in, then Forgot your password, to get a new one.
resetPage.doneBody: Sign in with your new password. For safety you're signed out on every device.
resetPage.title: Choose a new password
resetPage.intro: Pick something you don't use elsewhere. At least 8 characters.
